runs.title: Built .config holds every P2 setting and meets the boot-loader policy; each control build changes exactly one setting

checks.pattern: CONFIG_BOOTCOMMAND="virtio scan; virtio read 0x50000000 0 0x20000; bootm 0x50000000; reset"
CONFIG_FIT_SIGNATURE=y: signed FIT configurations are verified
CONFIG_ENV_IS_NOWHERE=y: the environment is the one compiled into the image
CONFIG_MEASURED_BOOT=y: what is booted is measured into the TPM
CONFIG_MEASURE_DEVICETREE=y: the devicetree is measured too
CONFIG_LEGACY_IMAGE_FORMAT is off: legacy uImages, which carry no signature, are not booted
CONFIG_BOOTSTD_BOOTCOMMAND is off: no scan of disks for unsigned scripts or extlinux.conf
CONFIG_USE_PREBOOT is off: no preboot command runs before the boot command
no CONFIG_ENV_IS_IN_* is on: no environment is read from flash, MMC or a file system
CONFIG_BOOTDELAY=-2: autoboot with no check for a keypress
the boot command is used and ends in reset, so a refused boot reaches no prompt
ctl-bootdelay differs from hardened only by ['CONFIG_BOOTDELAY=2']
ctl-bootdelay breaks only the policy rule no-autoboot-delay
ctl-noreset differs from hardened only by ['CONFIG_BOOTCOMMAND="virtio scan; virtio read 0x50000000 0 0x20000; bootm 0x50000000"']
ctl-noreset breaks only the policy rule reset-after-boot-command
tc06-version differs from hardened only by ['CONFIG_LOCALVERSION="-p2-tc06"']
tc06-bootargs differs from hardened only by ['CONFIG_BOOTARGS="console=ttyAMA0 rdinit=/init panic=-1 p2.tc06=1"']
stock breaks the policy rules its control runs rely on: ['env-not-stored', 'no-legacy-image']
